name: video-prompt-reverse
title_zh: 逐镜头拆解视频，输出带证据帧的中英提示词包
tagline_zh: 别再对着成片瞎猜提示词。它把每个镜头拆成可复现的生成规格，附上证据帧，中英双语提示词直接可用，适配 Veo。
tagline_en: Stop guessing prompts from a finished video. It breaks each shot into reproducible specs with evidence frames.
desc_en: Reverse-engineer a supplied video into a shot-by-shot generation specification, displayed evidence frames, and paired Chinese-English prompt packages. Use for requests such as 视频反推提示词, 视频转提示词, 从视频生成提示词, 视频逆向提示词, 逐镜头反推, 分镜拆解并生成提示词, 反推视频 prompt, or video-to-prompt; also use for Veo, Sora, Kling, Wan, generic prompt adaptation, and bounded generate-compare-optimize loops. Do not use for ordinary vide
why_zh: 不是笼统描述画面，而是逐镜头反推：构图、运镜、主体动作、光影、时长逐一拆解，证据帧让你核对每一步。
why_en: Not vague scene description—it reverse-engineers shot by shot: framing, camera move, subject action, lighting, duration, each.
limit_zh: 只反推视频本身可见的内容，不补脑内未呈现的意图；输出到提示词包为止，不含生成、比对或优化步骤。
limit_en: Only what's visible in the video—no hidden intent. Output ends at prompt packages; no generation or optimization. Needs a parseable video file; no.
title_en: Reverse video into shot-by-shot prompts with evidence frames
